meta.purpose: Summary of identified pagination issues, applied fixes, and validation results

issues_identified.description: Multiple page parameters in query string (e.g., ?page=3&page=2)
issues_identified.impact: Unpredictable pagination results, inconsistent page navigation
issues_identified.fix_applied: Normalize to first valid integer value, discard duplicates

issues_identified.description: Invalid page values (negative, zero, empty, non-integer)
issues_identified.impact: Application crashes, invalid pagination links, user confusion
issues_identified.fix_applied: Clamp negative/zero to 1, default invalid values to 1

issues_identified.description: Extremely large page values causing expensive database OFFSET scans
issues_identified.impact: Database resource exhaustion, slow responses, potential DoS

issues_identified.description: Array-encoded parameters (page[]=2&page[]=3) not recognized by Flask parser
issues_identified.impact: Pagination falls back to default, user sees unexpected first page
issues_identified.fix_applied: Detect and extract first valid integer from array parameters

issues_identified.description: Inconsistent parameter names across clients (p, limit, size, offset)
issues_identified.impact: API contract divergence, broken navigation links
issues_identified.fix_applied: Map all aliases to canonical parameters, convert offset/limit to page/per_page

issues_identified.description: Queries ordered by timestamp without deterministic tiebreakers
issues_identified.impact: Non-repeatable pagination, duplicate/missing items across page refreshes
issues_identified.fix_applied: Automatically append secondary sort key (id DESC) for deterministic ordering

issues_identified.description: Different cache layers cache inconsistent query-string variants
issues_identified.impact: Data mismatches, user confusion, potential data leakage
issues_identified.fix_applied: Generate canonical URLs, mark user-dependent routes as non-cacheable

issues_identified.description: User-dependent paginated views cached without user context
issues_identified.fix_applied: Set Cache-Control: private, Vary: Authorization headers

fixes: Safe integer parsing with fallback to defaults
Deterministic ordering with secondary sort keys
Comprehensive test coverage for all issue categories

database_queries.after: Bounded to max_page_allowed=1000, preventing resource exhaustion

cache_efficiency.before: Inconsistent URLs cached separately, low hit rates

query_stability.after: Deterministic ordering with secondary sort keys

deployment_recommendations.recommendation: Deploy request_normalizer as middleware to normalize all pagination requests
deployment_recommendations.impact: Prevents all identified issues at the request layer

deployment_recommendations.recommendation: Set Cache-Control headers for user-dependent routes
Implement rate limiting on pagination endpoints
Ensure database indexes on sort columns
